scope: Five publicly reachable stock placeholder candidates researched from official Mixkit item pages. No application, database or mainstream documentation was changed.

license.name: Mixkit Stock Video Free License
license.verified: Every selected official item page explicitly identifies the Stock Video Free License. It permits commercial and noncommercial projects and public performance, subject to the terms. Attribution is not required; credit is still recommended.
license.limits: Do not offer these as a stock download library, resell standalone copies or imply ownership or endorsement. The terms contain third party rights and other restrictions. The selected files are the actual playable HD Ready sources declared by the official item pages; no media filename or item ID was guessed. No production licence guarantee is made.

verification.http: Read-only HEAD and bytes=0-1023 GET requests to each direct URL. All returned HEAD200, GET206, video/mp4 and Accept-Ranges bytes. Small additional range reads inspected MP4 movie metadata. No full video file was downloaded to this repository.
verification.duration: durationSeconds is the browser HTMLMediaElement.duration observed while the official preview played. Values may differ by a fraction of a millisecond from the movie-header timescale; official page duration labels round to whole seconds.
verification.visual: All five official previews were played and visually inspected near the beginning, midpoint and end using the visible playback timeline. Sample times are recorded per clip. The chosen footage depicts natural landscapes or distant top-down traffic. No recognisable person was observed in these samples. This is not a biometric or exhaustive frame-by-frame rights review.
verification.cors: HEAD responses without an Origin header did not include Access-Control-Allow-Origin. Native video playback succeeded on official pages without crossOrigin. Do not assume canvas extraction or crossOrigin=anonymous will work; the application can use the provided poster instead.
verification.availability: External URLs and licensing may change. These checks record current accessibility and are not an uptime promise.
